description: The source identifies processed MoProVe data logs from vehicle CAN-bus measurements in Croatia at 100 Hz. Described columns include WGS84 latitude and longitude, front-wheel speed, three-axis acceleration and yaw, roll and pitch rates. These fields represent vehicle motion in a road-survey context and can support transport dynamics modelling. The native metadata do not state route identifiers, observation dates, vehicle type, variable units or the number of samples. This is a distinct telemetry product from the RoadLAB laser and road-profile outputs. Access is restricted, no file descriptors are exposed, and no measured trajectory or numeric value was inspected. The named source creators provide this metadata through Zenodo, whose deposits declare CC BY 4.0. Access restrictions and underlying provider terms remain separate from that declaration; cost is unknown unless explicitly stated. Geographic and temporal coverage are limited to the source-described roads, scenarios or periods. Metadata only was reviewed, with no files, measurements, imagery, archives or document bodies downloaded. Related components retain their distinct native identities and possible overlap. The described physical assets, observations or simulator outputs support road infrastructure simulation within these stated limits.
